record.label: Time evolution on grid states antisymmetric under same-spin exchange
record.description: For each $t=1,\ldots,10$ a.u., the circuit with clean ancillas must realize a single unitary $W$. On normalized grid states antisymmetric under exchange of same-spin electrons, $W$ must approximate $e^{-iHt}$ to error $\varepsilon=10^{-2}$ up to a global phase.
